input_text:
Synthetic example, not real intelligence. During the forensic triage of workstation WS-04, security operations detected internal discovery activity where the threat actor checked their current user privileges on the endpoint. The command execution recorded in the timeline was:
whoami.exe /priv
This command was invoked to enumerate the assigned security privileges and determine whether administrative tokens were available.
gate_reason: Caught extracted attack and hidden variant, quiet on benign line
rule_yaml:
title: Whoami Used To List Privileges
status: test
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\whoami.exe'
        CommandLine|contains|windash: '/priv'
    condition: selection
level: low
tags:
    - attack.discovery
    - attack.t1033
